articles.title: Qualcomm Stock Jumped 9% on Monday. Can It Bring More Meaningful Upside in 2026?
articles.description: Key TakeawaysAI Repricing: Qualcomm stock jumped 9% to $194 on Monday, September 21, after the company unveiled a die-to-die optical interconnect demo with Lumentum and Corning built for AI data centers. Street Flatlines: The 38 analysts TIKR tracks carry 9 buys, 2 outperforms, 23 holds, 2 underperforms and 1 sell, and their $194 mean target now sits exactly at the stock’s new price.

articles.title: Is Lumentum (LITE) Quietly Rewiring Its AI Data Center Role With New OCI Optics?
articles.description: Lumentum Holdings recently showcased its eight-wavelength DWDM External Laser SFP module and broader AI-focused optical solutions at ECOC 2026, underscoring its role in co-packaged and near-packaged optics aligned with the OCI MSA standard.
